The brief

Keep selection guidance and product data consistent across a twelve-page document. Readers need to compare instruments without confusing range, resolution and accuracy.

The layout approach

A technical catalog study organising measuring instruments around task, range and specification.

  • Editable comparison tables and product records
  • A stable typographic hierarchy for technical information
  • Credited instrument photography with clear context
